_doc: Ground truth for catalog suggestions (Task 2), written before the matcher. Each case is one order line as it appears in a request: either an extracted quote line or something a requester types. expected_items: catalog item descriptions (Acme's catalog) any of which is an acceptable suggestion. must_be_none: the catalog has nothing suitable, so no suggestion may be shown. Scored by backend/evals/run_match_eval.py. expected_quality: the badge each suggested item may get (equivalent = same product and key specs; close = only minor differences; alternative = a major difference such as platform, size class or custom vs standard). Items not listed may be close or alternative but never equivalent. Scored as 'label' (per suggestion) and 'stable' (same label across runs).
